sam: morning — async checkin
sam: what I did: merged routing-policy changes for shard-2 + fallback-to-light model, pushed to staging
sam: blocker: seeing intermittent 500s from auth during concurrency spike (around JWT parsing). don't have root cause yet, need help triaging
sam: today: run a 10% canary, open PR to rotate JWT lib or pin version, and re-run integration suite
anya: reading logs now — grabbing a trace and span ids
anya: trace: https://observability.redwood/incidents/trace/0x9bdf — seems errors spike when token header contains extra padding
kevin: quick look — stacktrace points to libjwt v2.1.0 parseToken -> NPE. pinned to 2.0.8 fixed locally
kevin: i'll open a hotfix PR to pin dependency + unit test
tess: will cut canary to 10% and watch latency/errors. tagging @kevin for the hotfix
tess: will run the canary command
tess: ```
# set canary weight
redwood rollout canary --route api-gateway --weight 10 --timeout 15m
```
deploy-bot: deploy: canary start requested by tess — id cny-202803
deploy-bot: canary: 10% traffic routing now
sam: PR link pls — i'll review + add integration test repro
sam: note: integration-tests intermittently timeout on auth mock; not sure if related
anya: i'll try to reproduce the timeout on staging, if failing i'll increase test timeouts
kevin: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/api-gateway/pulls/892 — pins libjwt to 2.0.8 and adds regression test
tess: ack — monitoring: https://console.redwood/metrics/gateway?range=15m
tess: if errors > 0.5% for 5m i'll rollback canary and notify oncall
deploy-bot: canary: 10% stable for 6m — errors 0.12% — continuing
sam: thanks team. assigning follow-ups: kevin (hotfix PR), anya (repro + logs), tess (canary + rollback logic). I'll do the review after standup :thumbsup:
anya: on it :eyes:
kevin: will cut the PR and request review from sam
tess: will watch dashboard and post updates here
sam: any other blockers? otherwise i'll close this thread in a few hours
kevin: none from me
